Contributing

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

Notes for fmm and future contributors.

Tests without a key

The tests make no network call and need no key.

  • Each test mocks the provider with httr2::local_mocked_responses(). The helper record_requests() in tests/testthat/helper-requests.R does this and keeps the requests, so a test can count and read them.
  • The mocked answers are saved provider responses in tests/testthat/fixtures/. fixture_response("<name>") turns one file into an httr2 response. Do not edit a saved response by hand. Make it again from a real call.
  • Tests use the fake key "not-a-real-key". Never use a string that starts with sk-.

Live tests

tests/testthat/test-live.R makes one tiny real call for each provider. These calls cost money. A live test runs only when:

  • DECISIONS_LIVE_TESTS=true, and
  • the key variable of the provider is set (TYPESAFE_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY).

Otherwise it skips and says why. To run them:

Sys.setenv(DECISIONS_LIVE_TESTS = "true")
devtools::test(filter = "live")

The Laya test is free. It needs DECISIONS_LIVE_LOCAL=true and a Laya server that answers http://localhost:8000/health. The test does not start a server.

The workflow .github/workflows/live-api.yaml runs the live tests by hand only. It reads the three keys from repository secrets.

Saved results of the vignettes

The vignettes make no call. They read saved results from inst/extdata/.

  • data-raw/vignette_results.R runs the live code of vignettes 1 to 4 and the grading vignette, and saves the results.
  • data-raw/study_again.R runs the pipeline of the vignette “industrial-image-inspection” in steps and saves the results.
  • Each paid call appends one row to a call log through data-raw/log_call.R. A budget row must exist before you make a paid call.

Keys

No key is ever written to a file. Scripts read keys with Sys.getenv(). Do not print a key, put it in a setup file, or commit .Renviron or .env. Before each commit, run git grep -c -E "sk-|Bearer [A-Za-z0-9]". It must print nothing.
